author: 5kO0
content:
Carried over from the prior #31 lint-sweep session (the DB resync wiped that issue's record but the code changes landed; see git diff). What's done so far:

PHASE 1 — Codegen pedantic allows
  - proto-blue-codegen emits #![allow(clippy::pedantic, clippy::nursery, clippy::all)] in every generated file (both leaf and mod.rs)
  - Regenerated proto-blue-api/src/generated/ (368 files); cargo fmt applied
  - Effect: ~663 warnings silenced (1313 → 650)

PHASE 2 — Workspace lints infrastructure
  - [workspace.lints.clippy] table with pedantic/nursery group at priority=-1 (allow) and categorical allows: missing_errors_doc, missing_panics_doc, module_name_repetitions, too_long_first_doc_paragraph
  - clippy.toml at workspace root with doc-valid-idents extending the default list with AT-Protocol terminology (AT-URI, DAG-CBOR, did:plc, P-256, K-256, NSID, TID, DPoP, PKCE, PAR, XRPC, MST, CID, etc.)
  - [lints] workspace = true added to all 16 crates + examples
  - scripts/clippy-pedantic.sh helper (CLI -W flags currently override config allows due to cargo lint priority semantics; the helper passes -A flags explicitly)

PHASE 3 — Auto-fix pass
  - cargo clippy --fix applied 7 non-trivial improvements: const fn (cid.rs), #[must_use] on TokenSet::from_response, doc-markdown backticks, redundant_clone removals, semicolon_if_nothing_returned
  - 3 broken wildcard_imports rewrites in proto-blue-api/src/moderation/{decision,labels,subjects}.rs reverted: clippy missed test-only types referenced via #[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; }

WHAT REMAINS — Tier-4 hand audit (the scope of THIS issue):
  ~425 pedantic+nursery warnings remain via scripts/clippy-pedantic.sh. Categories needing per-site judgment:
  - 45 cast warnings (cast_possible_truncation:35 + cast_sign_loss:5 + cast_possible_wrap:5) — concentrated in CID/varint parsing. Most should become try_from + error propagation; a few are provably safe and warrant localized #[allow] with a SAFETY-style comment
  - 7 significant_drop_tightening — Mutex/RwLock guard scope analysis (some real perf wins, some wash)
  - 8 match_same_arms — DRY decisions
  - 6 needless_pass_by_value — API signature audit
  - 1 collection_is_never_read — investigate (dead code or missing read site?)
  - Remaining minor: option_if_let_else, default_trait_access, items_after_statements, format_push_string, format_collect, assigning_clones, etc.

VERIFICATION as of this commit:
  - cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings: clean ✓
  - cargo fmt --all -- --check: clean ✓
  - cargo test --workspace: 1111 passed / 0 failed / 11 ignored ✓
  - ./scripts/clippy-pedantic.sh: 425 warnings (down from 1313 = 68% reduction)
